read. Let no mark be altered without seal, witness, and a hand
steady enough to hold the pen.

SUPPLEMENTAL WARDEN'S NOTES

Hollowvale is to be read as a place under guarded vigilance, not as
a refuge. The 7,594 troops recorded against it are its declared
garrison; the register does not say that every spear is rested, fed,
or willing. Still, the number stands, and numbers are the nearest
thing the Ashen Era has to certainty.

Hollowreach is to be read as a closed wound. Its founding in 56 AS
places it among the old core locations, yet quarantine has made
isolation its governing shape. No easing of containment is entered
here. No promise of release is entered here. The blank spaces are
intentional.

The Salt-Blind Leviathan is not to be judged by the absence of a
gaze. Sightless eyes do not mean blindness of purpose. Do not
mistake its slow movement for hesitation. The proper response to its
approach is to strengthen what may be strengthened, abandon what
cannot, and report the breach without embellishment—unless
embellishment is the only way to make the living understand.

End of roll. Ink dried under poor light. Seal pressed while the hand
still trembled.
